title.en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT, reaching 100 million users in two months
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT，两个月内达到 1 亿用户

searchSummary.en: When did ChatGPT launch? Released November 30, 2022, it reached 100 million users in 60 days — the fastest-growing app in history. Timeline, impact, and key milestones.
searchSummary.zhHans: ChatGPT 是什么时候发布的？2022 年 11 月 30 日，OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT，60 天破 1 亿用户，成为史上增长最快的应用。时间线与关键影响。

summary.en: OpenAI released ChatGPT, a conversational AI product based on GPT-3.5, free to the public on November 30, 2022. It reached 1 million users in 5 days and 100 million in 2 months, becoming the fastest-growing consumer application in history. The launch marked the moment AI became a mainstream conversation—not just for researchers and tech enthusiasts, but for policymakers, teachers, artists, and the general public worldwide.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日向公众免费发布了基于 GPT-3.5 的对话式 AI 产品 ChatGPT。5 天注册用户破百万，两个月达到 1 亿用户，成为史上增长最快的消费级应用。这个发布标志着 AI 成为主流话题——不再只是研究人员和科技爱好者的讨论，而是进入了全球政策制定者、教师、艺术家和普通公众的视野。

narrative.en: ChatGPT was not the first large language model, but it was the first to package the technology into a zero-friction consumer product. By combining an intuitive chat interface, free access, and GPT-3.5's conversational fluency, OpenAI created a cultural moment. Within weeks, educators worried about cheating, writers feared obsolescence, and every major tech company scrambled to respond. Microsoft deepened its OpenAI partnership with a $10 billion investment; Google declared a 'code red' and rushed to launch Bard (later Gemini). The launch changed how AI was governed. The EU accelerated its AI Act negotiations. The U.S. White House issued an Executive Order on AI safety. China imposed regulations on generative AI. For the first time, 'AI alignment' and 'AI safety' entered mainstream political vocabulary. ChatGPT's success also triggered labor actions—the 2023 WGA and SAG-AFTRA strikes in Hollywood made AI regulation a central demand. The service evolved rapidly: GPT-4 launched in March 2023 with multimodal capabilities; plugins, browsing, and code interpreter followed; voice and vision arrived by late 2023. By 2025, ChatGPT had hundreds of millions of weekly active users and had fundamentally changed how the world thought about work, education, creativity, and truth.
narrative.zhHans: ChatGPT 不是第一个大语言模型，但它是第一个将这项技术包装成零门槛消费品的产品。凭借直观的对话界面、免费访问和 GPT-3.5 的流畅对话能力，OpenAI 创造了一个文化时刻。数周之内，教育工作者担心作弊，写作者担心被取代，每家大型科技公司都紧急应对。微软加深了与 OpenAI 的合作，投资 100 亿美元；Google 发布了"红色代码"并匆忙推出 Bard（后更名为 Gemini）。这次发布改变了 AI 的治理方式。欧盟加速了 AI 法案谈判。美国白宫发布了关于 AI 安全的行政令。中国对生成式 AI 实施了监管规定。"AI 对齐"和"AI 安全"首次进入主流政治词汇。ChatGPT 的成功也引发了劳工行动——2023 年好莱坞编剧工会和演员工会的罢工将 AI 监管作为核心诉求。服务快速演进：GPT-4 于 2023 年 3 月发布，具备多模态能力；插件、浏览和代码解释器随后推出；语音和视觉功能在 2023 年底上线。到 2025 年，ChatGPT 拥有数亿周活跃用户，从根本上改变了世界对工作、教育、创造力和真相的思考方式。

description.en: For the first time, non-technical users could directly experience state-of-the-art LLM capabilities through natural conversation. The dialogue quality and instruction-following far exceeded all previous consumer AI products. GPT-4 (March 2023) added multimodal input, making the system useful across text, images, and code.
description.zhHans: 首次让非技术用户通过自然对话直接体验最先进的大语言模型能力。对话质量和指令遵循远超此前所有消费级 AI 产品。GPT-4（2023 年 3 月）增加了多模态输入，使系统在文本、图像和代码方面都有用。

description.en: Triggered an AI arms race among tech giants. Microsoft invested $10B in OpenAI and integrated ChatGPT into Bing, Office, and Windows. Google declared a 'code red.' Startups built on the OpenAI API proliferated while others were wiped out by GPT-4's expanding capabilities. The WGA and SAG-AFTRA strikes made AI regulation a central labor demand.
description.zhHans: 引发科技巨头间的 AI 军备竞赛。微软向 OpenAI 投资 100 亿美元并将 ChatGPT 整合进 Bing、Office 和 Windows。Google 发布了"红色代码"。基于 OpenAI API 的初创公司大量涌现，而其他公司则被 GPT-4 不断扩展的能力所消灭。WGA 和 SAG-AFTRA 罢工将 AI 监管作为核心劳工诉求。

description.en: Zero-barrier free registration brought AI to hundreds of millions globally, breaking the perception that AI was only for researchers and large corporations. Students, writers, small business owners, and artists worldwide gained access to a tool that could write, translate, code, and brainstorm.
description.zhHans: 零门槛免费注册使全球数亿人首次直接使用 AI，打破了 AI 仅限研究机构和科技公司的壁垒。全世界的学生、作家、小企业主和艺术家获得了能够写作、翻译、编码和头脑风暴的工具。

description.en: Exposed AI hallucinations, bias, copyright issues, and privacy concerns to public view at unprecedented scale. Accelerated regulatory action globally—EU AI Act, U.S. AI Executive Order, China's generative AI regulations—and made 'AI safety' a mainstream political concern.
description.zhHans: 将 AI 幻觉、偏见、版权侵权、隐私等问题以前所未有的规模暴露在公众视野。加速了全球监管行动——欧盟 AI 法案、美国 AI 行政令、中国生成式 AI 法规——使"AI 安全"成为主流政治关切。

description.en: 'AI as the next computing platform' shifted from industry consensus to global social consensus. Every sector—education, healthcare, law, software, art—began reassessing its relationship with AI. For the first time, the question 'what is the right relationship between humans and increasingly capable machines?' became a mainstream conversation rather than an academic one.
description.zhHans: "AI 是下一个计算平台"从行业共识变为全球社会共识。每个领域——教育、医疗、法律、软件、艺术——都开始重新评估其与 AI 的关系。"人类与日益强大的机器之间正确的关係是什么？"这个问题首次成为主流对话而非学术讨论。

text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2022年11月30日 发布 ChatGPT。

text.en: ChatGPT reached 100 million users within two months, making it the fastest-growing consumer application in history.
text.zhHans: ChatGPT 两个月达到 1 亿用户，成为史上增长最快的消费级应用。

sources.quote: We've trained a model called ChatGPT which interacts in a conversational way. The dialogue format makes it possible for ChatGPT to answer followup questions, admit its mistakes, challenge incorrect premises, and reject inappropriate requests.
ChatGPT is estimated to have reached 100 million monthly active users in January, just two months after launch, making it the fastest-growing consumer application in history.
Google declared a 'code red' after the launch of ChatGPT, fearing the chatbot could upend its search business.
